idea-plugin.name: Tide
idea-plugin.description:
The language of the Tide game engine.

Highlighting, completion, errors as you type with quick fixes, hover, go to definition, find usages, rename, formatting, parameter hints, inlay hints, the structure view, symbols across the game, folding, moving a declaration to a file of its own, and each system's schedule above it, for .tide files.

Run a game from its .tide files: in a window of its own, or on the web, in the IDE. Saving a file reloads it as it runs.

It runs tidels, the language server that comes with tide: install tide first (see the install steps), or choose a tidels under Settings | Languages & Frameworks | Tide. Then open your game's folder, the one you'd run tide run in: every .tide file in it is one game.
